figurative_meaning_en: Calling out 'father, father' when in crisis or distress
similar_in_english: Running to one's parents in trouble
Crying for mommy/daddy when things get tough
example_sentences_in_bangla: সঙ্কটের মুহূর্তে সে চাপ পড়লে বাপ বলে কাঁদতে লাগল।
জীবনে চাপ পড়লে বাপ, তখনই বোঝা যায় পরিবারের গুরুত্ব।
example_sentences_in_english: In the moment of crisis, he started crying 'father, father' like 'when pressure falls on father'.
When life gets tough, people realize the importance of family, just as in 'when pressure falls on father'.
note: This idiom reflects the cultural reliance on family support during hardships in Bengali society.
